name: Chieda Riichi
source:
Name: Riichi Chieda
Sex: Male
Age: 54 [spoiler](in [I]Past[/I]) | 60 (in [I]Present[/I])[/spoiler]
Birthday: Jan 18
Profession: Chairman of Aioen
Likes: Status, Fame, Power, Kizuna
Dislikes: The Unemployed, Ignorance, Rude People, Day Drinkers
Hobbies: Gold, Sailing, Wine, Bonsai, Animal Flossing
Skills: Horse-Riding, Curling, Getting Spanked

Besides being the chairman of Aioen, he's an investor, philanthropist, founder of the Chieda Foundation, and an honorary professor. He funded the reopening of Horadori Institute.

[From the in-game character description]

[spoiler]Riichi took in [url=/c112133]Mizuki (Bibi)[/url] when she was 9 years old. He funded the Horadori Institute to research methods of curing Mizuki's heart condition.[/spoiler]
